author: Kamil Mete Yalcinkaya
description: Detects Windows service installation events whose service name or image path matches remote execution utilities. PsExec and its reimplementations work by writing a service binary to ADMIN$ and registering it, so the service installation event is the durable artefact.
false_positives: Administrators who use PsExec as a sanctioned remote administration tool. Where that is the case, scope the rule to source hosts outside the administrative subnet.
name: Service Creation Consistent With Remote Execution Tooling
note: Investigation fields: service.name, file.path, user.name, host.name
query: (event.code : "7045" and ((service.name : "*PSEXESVC*" or service.name : "*PAExec*" or service.name : "*RemComSvc*" or service.name : "*CSExec*") or (file.path : "*\\PSEXESVC.exe*" or file.path : "*\\paexec*" or file.path : "*\\RemComSvc.exe*")))
